findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages all missed 2026-07-31 deadline — 19 days overdue; no paid traffic possible without these.
LSA + Search go-live and Meta Retargeting launch both missed 2026-08-01 — 18 days overdue; $0 spend across all 28 days confirms ads have never run.
GBP engagement fell -40.91% last 7 days vs prior 7; last 3 days (Aug 16–18) logged 1, 0, 0 actions vs 6, 5, 1 in the prior 3 — a confirmed 3-day deceleration.
Instagram reach dropped -40.13% week-over-week; last 3 days averaged 483 vs 1,013 prior 3 days — parallel decay with GBP signals reduced organic visibility, not just noise.
GHL shows 492 contacts and 0 opportunities created, 0 appointments — pipeline is not capturing any inbound; intake routing from SOW Month 1 appears unbuilt.

suggestions.text: Clear all 5 overdue SOW blockers this week; no paid budget should move until launch stack is verified.

No paid spend — $0 across 28 days — can begin until these are cleared. Nacer to confirm completion of each blocker by 2026-08-22; Sohib to gate any budget release on that confirmation.
